annotations.title: Place a REAL order (cash on delivery)

description: Places a real cash-on-delivery order for the shopper. A call-center operator phones the given number to confirm, then a courier delivers and collects payment. The order is accepted only with customer_confirmed=true, meaning the shopper explicitly confirmed the product, variant, total and phone number.

agent.description: Name of the assistant placing the order, e.g. "ChatGPT".

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true: the shopper explicitly confirmed this order.

variant_id.description: Required if the product has variants; variant ids are listed in the product details.

variant_type_id.description: Required if the chosen variant has types.

name: place_order
title: Place a REAL order (cash on delivery)
